content: GitHub Actions -> S3/CF deploy security: prefer OIDC (role-to-assume) over long-lived keys; workflow permissions id-token:write contents:read; IAM least-privilege: s3:PutObject/DeleteObject/ListBucket/GetBucketLocation on one bucket ARN + cloudfront:CreateInvalidation on one distribution ARN; environment:production gate; concurrency group to prevent racing deploys; aws sts get-caller-identity sanity check.
